qa_pair.question: In the fixture database, find the Aurora parser remote code execution published between 1 and 10 March 2024. Confirm its KEV membership with a summary lookup. What is its CVE identifier? Return only the identifier.
Find the fixture CVEs added to KEV on 1 April 2024. Retrieve their summaries in a batch and compare CVSS 3.1 base scores. Which CVE has the highest score? Return only its identifier.
Search the fixture CVEs published between 1 and 10 March 2024. Use a batch lookup to compare all their CVSS 3.1 scores. Which identifier has the lowest score? Return only the identifier.

Find the fixture Aurora parser CVE. Inspect its full applicability record, then resolve its CPE match criteria. What is the exclusive upper version bound on its Aurora range beginning at 1.0? Return only the version string.
Read the fixture change history of CVE-2024-1001 with pageSize 1, following every cursor. What is the eventName of its final, newest change? Return the exact eventName and nothing else.

Page through the fixture CPE match criteria for CVE-2024-1001 with pageSize 1. Find the criterion for Aurora 2.0 and use its matches dictionary identifier to fetch that CPE entry. Return the dictionary entry's full cpeName.

Search the fixture CPE Dictionary for Aurora, including deprecated entries. Follow the deprecated entry's deprecatedBy identifier with a dictionary lookup. Return the replacement entry's full cpeName.

Read two consecutive pages of the fixture modified CVE feed for 1 through 10 March 2024, with pageSize 2. Verify that the four identifiers do not repeat and compare lastModified timestamps across both pages. Which identifier was modified most recently? Return only the identifier.

Read both pages of the fixture recent CVE feed for 1 through 10 March 2024, with pageSize 2. Verify the publication ordering and find the oldest publication in that window. Return only its CVE identifier.
Search the fixture CPE Dictionary for Aurora without deprecated entries. Fetch the surviving entry by its dictionary identifier and read its English title. Return that exact title and nothing else.
